COMPLETION EVIDENCE — the method-body LOC the attestation was missing.

The prior attestation recorded the FILE figure only. The criterion requires BOTH, and explicitly notes
the method figure is tracked separately because it has been repeatedly under-projected. Measured on the
merged commit and its parent, via ast (function start line to end_lineno), not by eye:

  src/rebar/llm/runner.py                     BEFORE 699 LOC   AFTER 658 LOC   (-41)
  PydanticAIRunner.run() METHOD BODY          BEFORE 342 LOC   AFTER 300 LOC   (-42)
                                              (lines 259-600  ->  lines 260-559)

Merged commit: 8b44b5aa50 (Gerrit change 1213, submitted with the epic stack). Local pre-merge SHA was
8aa86fe097; Gerrit rewrote it on submit under Rebase-If-Necessary, so 8b44b5aa50 is the authoritative
commit on origin/main and the one this measurement is taken from.

Method used, reproducible:
  git show 8b44b5aa50~1:src/rebar/llm/runner.py  -> parse, locate PydanticAIRunner.run, end_lineno-lineno+1
  git show 8b44b5aa50:src/rebar/llm/runner.py    -> same

The extraction moved build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success and record_call_spend into
src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py (152 LOC, clearing the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor). One seam was
deliberately NOT extracted: _anthropic_web_search_capabilities is a runner-module global that the suite
patches via monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...); calling it from agent_call.py would resolve the name
through that module's globals and silently defeat the patch. web_caps stays resolved in run() and is
passed in.
